results.title: Google Gemini now has over 1 billion users
results.description: It is no secret that artificial intelligence is enjoying huge popularity, and the same is true of AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT and Google Gemini. In fact, Google’s own tool has proven to be its fastest-growing product ever. Sundar Pichai has revealed that the Gemini app now has an astonishing one billion users, meaning that the tool is now used by a massive proportion of the global population.
